name: @kubuno/host-runtime
description: Kubuno web views design host - the Visual Studio design surface page: a static build in bundled mode (React, @ui, the sdk, the @kubuno/views runtime, the .kbview compiler's WebAssembly, the host registry, the host CSS with the production fonts, the core's translations and the light / dark Kubuno themes), and the project-mode page of module projects with the host's shared modules, served by the module's own Vite dev server.
